question.question: What is the most effective way to begin an interaction with a healthcare customer?

options.text: Present the most relevant product information first and use the customer’s responses to refine the discussion
options.value: Present the most relevant product information first and use the customer’s responses to refine the discussion

options.text: Begin with a concise overview of the product portfolio, then invite the customer to identify areas of interest
options.value: Begin with a concise overview of the product portfolio, then invite the customer to identify areas of interest

options.text: Use a set of prepared questions to ensure the conversation covers all the key product messages
options.value: Use a set of prepared questions to ensure the conversation covers all the key product messages

options.text: Ask thoughtful questions to understand the customer’s practice, priorities and challenges before discussing a product
options.value: Ask thoughtful questions to understand the customer’s practice, priorities and challenges before discussing a product
